acceptance: Owner approval for the scratch repository (name, owner) is recorded here before it is created.
Raw GraphQL and REST responses before and after minimise are saved under ~/Developer/benchmark_runs/review-minimize-probe-<date>/ and summarised here with the exact field values.
Theseus's edit detectors (the functions behind T6) are run offline on the after-minimise objects and their result is recorded.

Decision recorded: GO (lastEditedAt null, includesCreatedEdit false, body unchanged, inline threads visible and repliable, Theseus detectors do not fire) or NO-GO with the failing field; on NO-GO, theseus-review-minimize-superseded-20261110 is dropped with this evidence as the reason.
Scratch repository cleanup is done or handed to the owner with the exact commands.
description:
Decision gate for theseus-review-minimize-superseded-20261110. Theseus treats any edited bot review or thread as tampering and holds the PR (protocol.py ~:396-402, review_check.py ~:138-146, dedup.py ~:39, cli.py ~:264: lastEditedAt / includesCreatedEdit). The redesign wants to collapse superseded verdict reviews with the GraphQL `minimizeComment(classifier: OUTDATED)` mutation on PullRequestReview. Evidence so far is indirect (212 of 213 minimised issue comments on cli/cli had lastEditedAt null). A wrong guess would hold every PR, so this must be observed directly before any code is written.
Probe, no model calls: in a scratch repository approved by the owner, open a PR, post a PullRequestReview with a body and two inline comments (as the authenticated user; if the owner approves, also as a GitHub App installation token), then minimise the review with classifier OUTDATED, and read back via GraphQL: review lastEditedAt, includesCreatedEdit, isMinimized, minimizedReason, body unchanged; each inline comment's lastEditedAt, isMinimized, and whether its thread is still visible/resolvable/repliable; and the REST review and comment objects. Then run Theseus's own edit-detection functions on the fetched objects (offline script against the real responses) to show they do not flag them. Also record whether unminimize restores the state.
Guardrails: scratch repository only, never BenchBox or Theseus PRs; creating it is an external action that needs the owner's explicit approval in the current task; record the exact repo and delete instructions; no secrets in logs; no live model calls.
